text:
Situation: Azacitidine has been on FDA's shortage list since 2020-12-18 and remains current as of 2026-10-21. Our Corvale General and Corvale East sites both stock NDC 16729-306-10 labeled by Accord Healthcare Inc. That NDC's SPL set ID 70140e11 identifies Intas Pharmaceuticals Limited as the manufacturing plant.

Why (FDA record): FDA inspection 1191818 at Intas Pharmaceuticals Limited ended 2022-12-02 and was classified OAI with 11 observations on the Form 483. The OAI classification letter is dated 2023-04-05, which is 714 days after the shortage posting on 2020-12-18. An import alert 66-40 and a warning letter were later issued to Intas Pharmaceuticals Limited in 2023.

Our position: Corvale General holds two lots totaling 88 units (11.3 and 19.6 days on hand). Corvale East holds two lots totaling 75 units (16.1 and 9 days on hand). Corvale Lakeside holds two lots totaling 22 units (18.2 and 12.7 days on hand). The rule‑ranked transfer would move 15 units from Corvale General to Corvale East, giving each site approximately 14 days on hand.

Recommended actions:
1. Approve transfer of 15 units of azacitidine 100 mg from Corvale General to Corvale East — requires pharmacy director approval of the transfer request.
2. Evaluate purchase from BluePoint Laboratories (Sindan-Pharma Srl plant, last inspection NAI 2024-08-02) — requires buyer approval.
3. Evaluate purchase from Amneal Pharmaceuticals LLC — requires buyer approval.
4. Evaluate purchase from Apotex Corp — requires buyer approval.
5. Evaluate purchase from BluePoint Laboratories (alternate label) — requires buyer approval.

Not recommended: No clinical dosing changes or alternative regimens; those decisions rest with treating clinicians and the committee.
